svt_sequence class inheritance diagram.

Sequence Group Sequence Subgroup Sequences Sequences Description Controls Sequencer
COMPLEX_SEQUENCES
* This group contains all the command amd video frame sequences
COMMAND_MODE_SEQUENCES
* This group contains all the command frame sequences
 svt_mipi_dsi_dcs_write_read_sequence This sequence creates a scenerio for DCS write followed by DCS Read. Sequence length represents number of such iterations. User control: Max return packet size sequence_length
Number of DCS write/read sequences

Number of Generic write/read sequences

svt_mipi_dsi_memory_write_frame_sequence This sequence creates as scenerio for writing a frame in the memory of the display controller. User Control: The user can control bytes per line, no. of lines sequence length, VC ID etc. mem_frm_vc_id
Virtual chaanel id for memory frame

First payload byte of the memory line packet

mem_vc_id
Virtual channel id for memory line
